about.title: Dr. Habib Khalaf
about.content:
Welcome to Khalaf Canon Law, where expertise meets compassion in matters of canon law. With years of dedicated service and specialized training, we provide professional guidance for individuals and families navigating complex ecclesiastical matters.

Our practice is built on a foundation of deep theological knowledge, extensive legal training, and a genuine commitment to helping clients through sensitive and important matters of faith and family.

  • Doctor of Canon Law (J.C.D.)
  • Pontifical Lateran University, Rome – Italy
  • Licensed Canon Lawyer
  • Specialist in Marriage Cases
  • Expert in Divorce Consultations

items.title: Marriage Tribunals
items.text: Expert representation and guidance through the canonical marriage tribunal process, ensuring your case is presented clearly and effectively.

items.title: Annulment Consultations
items.text: Compassionate and professional assistance in understanding and pursuing the annulment process within the Catholic Church.

items.title: Canon Law Advisory
items.text: Comprehensive consultation on all matters of canon law, providing clarity and direction for complex ecclesiastical questions.

items.title: Family Matters
items.text: Sensitive guidance for families facing difficult decisions regarding marriage, separation, and related canonical concerns.

items.title: Case Preparation
items.text: Thorough preparation and documentation assistance for ecclesiastical tribunal cases, ensuring all requirements are met.

items.title: Mediation Services
items.text: Professional mediation in canon law disputes, working toward just and pastoral solutions for all parties involved.
